def_en: 1) to advise, consult, give counsel, counsel, purpose, devise, plan
1a1) to advise, counsel, give counsel, consult
1b) (Niphal) to consult together, exchange counsel, deliberate, counsel together
kjv: advertise, take advise, advise (well), consult, (give, take) counsel(-lor), determine, devise, guide, purpose.
expl: to advise; reflexively, to deliberate or resolve
